author: Dx21

author: Da_Vid_Acre

author: Matias_Luge

author: Coverr-Free-Footage
desc: a0. A miniature Christmas village fills the frame, snow-dusted houses and trees with small figurines, a model railway track curving across the foreground and a toy train at the right edge; serves the opening beat of a finished miniature world.

author: RDNE Stock project

author: RDNE Stock project
desc: a0. A man in green at right places a wooden block on top of a tall stacked block tower at centre while a woman watches smiling from the left; serves the opening beat of adults playing a stacking game.

author: Pavel Danilyuk

author: Pavel Danilyuk

author: Everett Bumstead

author: Everett Bumstead
desc: a1. Close view of a hand plane moving along a board, motion-blurred shavings in the foreground and the dark plane body at the left edge, workshop blurred behind; serves the close-up planing beat.

author: Gustavo Fring
desc: a1. Two hands push a small plane along a plank running diagonally from centre to lower right, curled shavings resting on the plank in the foreground; serves the hand-planing beat.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. Hands at upper right pull a red hand saw through an upright board at centre, orange clamps blurred at left and shavings on the bench below; serves the hand-sawing beat.

author: Juan Pablo Gómez
desc: a1. A hand at lower right grips a pale plank running diagonally while pale wood chips burst off the plank end at upper right against a dark background; serves the shaping-wood beat.

author: Mr. Cinematographer
desc: a1. A craftsman in a sleeveless top at right shapes a long wooden blank with a small plane at lower centre, curled shavings at lower left; serves the craftsman-at-work beat.

author: Nishant Aneja
desc: a1. A worker in a dusty shirt guides a yellow-disc electric sander along a long plank running diagonally across the frame; serves the sanding beat.

author: Ono Kosuki
desc: a1. A pale wood piece sits at centre on a dark bench with curled shavings around it, a person's arm blurred at upper left working a plane; serves the planing beat.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. A craftsman in a plaid shirt and apron at right spreads finish over a board on a bench at centre, open paste tubs and an orange lid in the foreground, drill press and clamps blurred behind; serves the workshop finishing beat.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. A craftsman in a checked shirt and dark apron at centre works a vertical board clamped in a vice, shavings and tools on the bench at left, bright window at left background; serves the workshop beat.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. Top-down view of a workbench holding a set square, drill bit, safety glasses, clamp, hammer, wooden hand plane and two piles of wood shavings; serves the establishing shot of the carpenter's tools.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. Hands sweep wood dust off a board at centre, a sander and a hand plane resting on the bench below and shavings piled at right; serves the workshop clean-up beat.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a1. A craftsman in an apron raises a wooden mallet in his left hand above a chisel held vertical at lower centre, wood shavings scattered on the bench; serves the mallet-and-chisel beat.

author: Ono Kosuki
desc: a1. Close view of hands working a chisel into a pale plank at lower centre, a hammer held at the left edge, wood grain and shavings around the cut; serves the close-up chiselling beat.

author: Artyom Hunter
desc: a1. Aerial view drifting over a flat green settlement of houses among trees, a road running through the centre and open fields at right; modern footage used as a proxy for the flat Danish countryside around 1930s Billund, not Billund itself.

author: David Pickup
desc: a1. Aerial view of a modern row of new houses with cars parked along a road in the foreground and green fields behind; modern footage used as a proxy for flat Danish countryside, not 1930s Billund.

author: Usman AbdulrasheedGambo
desc: a2. White plastic granules pour in a steady stream from a bag at the top of the frame into a growing heap filling the foreground, blurred factory machinery behind; the pour never stops, beat: raw plastic feeding the moulding lines at full tilt.

author: gusat silviu
desc: a2. A heavy steel mould press fills the frame in close-up, its upper plate working over red mould pieces below, a green factory wall and a control cabinet at the left edge; the press cycles as the camera holds still, beat: injection moulding running nonstop.

author: Адам Аушев
desc: a2. A red moulding press closes over a tan shoe sole in a factory, a blue plastic crate intruding at the right edge; the press lowers and lifts in close-up, beat: moulding as the core manufacturing step.

author: Erkan Avanoğlu
desc: a2. A wrapped bundle sits at the far end of a long blue conveyor belt that fills the foreground, yellow sacks piled behind it on both sides; the belt line stretches away through a warehouse, beat: finished goods on the line.

author: Thanh Văn
desc: a2. Blue trays carrying parcels travel along a sorting conveyor, one blurred parcel passing close in the foreground and the line of trays stretching into the distance; the trays keep moving along the belt, beat: distribution at scale.

author: SHVETS production
desc: a2. Hands in the foreground pull tape across a large cardboard box, stacks of sealed boxes filling the background; the taping motion repeats as the camera stays low and close, beat: packing lines boxing up endless product.

author: Usman AbdulrasheedGambo
desc: a2. An orange forklift driven by a worker in a red helmet carries a large wrapped roll on its forks across a bright warehouse floor, the load in the centre of the frame; the forklift drives across the frame, beat: warehouse muscle moving stock.

author: Tiger Lily
desc: a2. A wide warehouse aisle runs down the centre between tall orange racks stacked high with shrink-wrapped pallets on both sides, a doorway glowing at the far end; the camera holds on the sheer fullness, beat: warehouses stuffed to the roof.

author: Mahadi Hassan Molla
desc: a2. A warehouse aisle recedes between red and blue racks crammed with white sacks and boxes on every shelf, daylight filtering through the roof above; the camera looks straight down the packed aisle, beat: inventory piling up.

author: Michael Rocha Mendez
desc: a2. From above, a forklift carrying a bright green crate manoeuvres beside a flatbed truck parked outside a warehouse, cars on the street at the right edge; the forklift works the load toward the truck bed, beat: goods shipping out.

author: EJ Merl
desc: a2. A red semi truck with a long silver trailer drives past the camera from left to right on a road, dry grassy hills rising behind it; the truck grows larger as it approaches, beat: distribution on the road.

author: Vlad Vasnetsov
desc: a2. A young girl seen from behind browses a toy store aisle, her hand reaching toward plush toys on shelves that fill the right of the frame; she moves slowly along the packed shelves, beat: shelves full of product for kids to choose from.

author: Charlie Mounsey
desc: a2. A close-up pile of colourful vintage tin toy robots fills the frame, one silver robot with a round dial sharp in the left foreground and others blurred behind; the camera drifts slightly over the heap, beat: product variety, line after line.

author: Somogro Bangladesh
desc: a2. A wide outdoor toy stall under a striped canopy displays hundreds of colourful hanging toys, a shopper in black walking past at the right edge; the stall sprawls across the whole frame, beat: toys everywhere, sold everywhere.

author: Aleson Padilha
desc: a2. An aerial view sweeps over a theme park: a yellow and red roller coaster coils at the lower left, a tall drop tower rises in the centre, and a lakeside stage sits at the right; the drone glides forward over trees and rides, beat: LEGOLAND-scale ambition.

author: Harvey Tan Villarino
desc: a2. Pink and blue roller coaster cars full of riders speed along a bright green track, the cars banking through the upper right of the frame against a pale sky; the train rushes past the camera, beat: the theme park thrill.

author: Anastasia Shuraeva
desc: a2. A family seen from behind plays twin motorcycle racing arcade machines, their screens glowing and handlebars lit, in a dark arcade; the players lean into the game as the screens flash, beat: expansion into video games and arcades.

author: Sam Lion
desc: a2. Two women browse a clothing rack in a bright boutique, one holding up a striped shirt on a hanger in the foreground while a mannequin in a white dress stands at the right; they compare garments casually, beat: LEGO branching into apparel.

author: Mat Brown
desc: a2. A classic wristwatch face fills the frame in close-up, Roman numerals around a white dial with small day, date and month subdials and a moonphase window at the bottom; the second hand ticks as the camera holds, beat: LEGO branching into watches.

author: Gustavo Fring
desc: a2. A young boy sits on a living room floor building with large colourful plastic bricks, a tall blue and yellow tower standing at the right and a baseplate of bricks spread before him; he reaches for pieces as he builds, beat: the core brick, still the heart of it all.

author: Advancer Drones
desc: a3. A vast empty warehouse stretches into darkness, its polished concrete floor reflecting thin strips of light, rows of bare columns receding to a distant glow; the camera looks down the empty hall, beat: the warehouses that were once full, now hollow.

author: CityXcape
desc: a3. Supermarket shelves stand almost bare, only a few jars and boxes left scattered across otherwise empty metal racks; the frame fills with gaps where stock used to be, beat: shelves with nothing left to sell.

author: Greg Thames
desc: a3. A large sign reading TEMPORARILY CLOSED fills a shop window, the street reflected dimly in the glass; the camera holds still on the sign, beat: shops shutting their doors.

author: Gustavo Fring
desc: a3. A woman in a checked shirt holds up a white sign reading SORRY WE'RE CLOSED beside a clothing rack with shirts on hangers; she stands still facing the camera, beat: the human face of closure.

author: RDNE Stock project
desc: a3. Hands pack papers and folders into an open cardboard box on an office desk, pens, a phone and a plant scattered around it; the hands place item after item into the box, beat: packing up a desk for good.

author: Mikhail Nilov
desc: a3. A man carries a cardboard box topped with a green plant out of an office, colleagues blurred at desks behind him and a chart glowing on a screen at the right; he walks toward the camera with his belongings, beat: staff leaving with their things in a box.

author: SHVETS production
desc: a3. Cardboard boxes of many sizes crowd an empty room, some stacked high at the edges and some tipped over in the foreground; the camera sits low among the boxes, beat: stock packed away for clearance.

author: Kampus Production
desc: a3. A bright modern office stands completely empty, rows of desks with dark monitors and unoccupied chairs, a sofa in the foreground; no one moves in the frame, beat: the office after everyone has gone.

author: Werner Pfennig
desc: a3. An empty conference room table curves through the frame, microphones and blank name cards placed along it, chairs pushed back; the camera moves slowly along the deserted table, beat: meetings that no longer happen.

author: Rafael Minguet Delgado
desc: a3. Trading screens glow in a dark room, the nearest screen showing a candlestick chart falling in red steps toward the lower right, other charts blurred behind; the red candles descend as the camera holds, beat: the numbers falling apart.

author: MART PRODUCTION
desc: a3. A man in a coat and cap stands outdoors holding an open newspaper, its pages spread wide in front of him, a pale building wall behind; he reads with the paper held high, beat: the crisis in the press.

author: Simon
desc: a3. A red poster reading CLOSING DOWN SALE fills a shop window, clothes racks visible behind the glass and smaller notices stuck to the door at the left; the camera holds on the poster, beat: everything must go.

author: Ojyrai Films
desc: a3. A derelict warehouse interior fills the frame, graffiti on broken concrete walls, sunlight through high windows, debris and a rusted vehicle on the dirt floor; the camera moves slowly through the ruin, beat: what is left after the collapse.

author: Mikhail Nilov
desc: a4. A man in a white shirt sits at the right of the frame at a desk covered with charts, a closed laptop, a phone and notebooks, talking with colleagues off camera, a dark screen behind him on the left; serves the turnaround meeting beat.

author: Mikhail Nilov
desc: a4. Three colleagues gather around a laptop at a desk, a woman on the left gesturing while a man stands behind her and another woman listens, sticky notes on the glass at left and colour swatches and plants on the desk; serves the brainstorming meeting beat.

author: Mikhail Nilov
desc: a4. A woman in a white shirt stands in the right foreground holding a black folder and presenting to a seated man in the centre, sticky notes on the glass behind them; serves the leadership presenting the refocus plan beat.

author: Mikhail Nilov
desc: a4. Three colleagues sit at a table smiling, the woman in the right foreground gesturing while the man in the centre smiles, sticky notes on the glass at right; serves the lighter mood of agreement after hard decisions.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a4. A group sits around a table, a man in the right foreground holding a pencil up as he speaks, a woman at left with a laptop and a suited man in the centre listening, a green plant wall behind; serves the group business meeting beat.

author: Gustavo Fring
desc: a4. A suited man in profile on the right holds a sheet of paper and speaks, a laptop at left and a screen behind him showing a rising line chart marked 12.002; serves the presenting results and strategy beat.

author: Kampus Production
desc: a4. A bearded man on the right studies a wall at left covered with charts and pink and yellow sticky notes marked 2020 and 2021, while a hand at the bottom right places another pink note; serves the refocus planning beat.

author: Yan Krukau
desc: a4. Overhead view of hands over a large floor plan on a marble table, one hand pointing with a pencil in the centre and another sketching a small shape in a notebook at right; serves the design review beat.

author: Yaroslav Shuraev
desc: a4. Close-up of a hand holding a wooden set square steady over a technical drawing covered with fine lines and measurements; serves the precise design and drawing beat.

author: RDNE Stock project
desc: a4. A woman in maroon at left points at a large rolled floor plan spread on a table while two colleagues stand at the table, a material sample at right; serves the design review beat.

author: RDNE Stock project
desc: a4. A group stands around a wooden table covered with rolled plans and material samples, hands pointing at the drawings and holding a roll; serves the team design discussion beat.

author: RDNE Stock project
desc: a4. Close-up of hands annotating a plan with pens, a red circled mark and red and green corrections visible on the paper; serves the checking and quality control on paper beat.

author: Tiger Lily
desc: a4. Two workers load plain cardboard boxes, large boxes filling the foreground and a van door at right; serves the streamlined distribution and logistics beat.

author: Yaroslav Shuraev
desc: a4. Two people at a desk review technical drawings on a laptop screen at right, one pointing at the screen with a pencil while the other types, paper plans spread on the desk and a bookshelf behind; serves the design review on screen beat.

author: Thiago Zanutim Lucas

author: Thiago Zanutim Lucas

author: Thiago Zanutim Lucas
desc: a4. Close-up of a gloved hand guiding oranges from a blue chute down into a red crate; serves the hands-on packing and sorting beat.

author: khanhhoangminh
desc: a5. A busy multi-level shopping mall interior, shoppers walking toward the camera in the centre and at left, escalators in the middle distance and lit shopfronts and food display cases at right; serves the busy retail comeback beat (a mall, not a LEGO store).

author: Antoni Shkraba

author: Antoni Shkraba

author: Antoni Shkraba
desc: a5. Four friends stand together in a museum hall in front of a stone wall, the man at left holding a red notebook, all facing the camera; serves the group exhibition visit beat.

author: Antoni Shkraba
desc: a5. Two women stand in the foreground of a gallery, one holding up a phone, while a man behind them studies large framed paintings on the walls; serves the exhibition visitors beat.

author: Antoni Shkraba

author: Lê Cuộc

author: Artem Podrez

author: Artem Podrez

author: Artem Podrez

author: Artem Podrez

author: Pavel Danilyuk
desc: a6. Two researchers in white coats and safety glasses stand at right, one holding a controller, while a silver robotic arm rises at left and moves its gripper; serves the modern automated factory beat, showing human operators directing a robot, not a LEGO factory.

author: Pavel Danilyuk
desc: a6. A grey robotic arm extends horizontally from the lower left toward a man and woman in lab coats at right who study a controller; the arm articulates as they watch, serving the human-robot collaboration beat.

author: Pavel Danilyuk
desc: a6. In profile, an elderly bearded man in a lab coat holds a controller at right and gestures toward a tall robotic arm at left, with a woman behind it holding a clipboard; the arm moves as he directs it, serving the automation beat.

author: Pavel Danilyuk
desc: a6. A black robotic arm on a table at left holds a small red flower in its gripper while a woman in a white shirt watches from the right against a blue-red studio backdrop; the arm moves delicately, serving the precision automation beat.

author: Taka Soyama
desc: a6. Sealed coffee bags move along a metal conveyor from background left to foreground right in a factory hall, with machinery behind; serves the modern production line beat, showing packaged goods on an automated line, not LEGO bricks.

author: K
desc: a6. Close-up of an industrial band saw cutting a metal bar at centre, coolant dripping, with the blade moving vertically; serves the modern factory machinery beat, showing metal fabrication, not LEGO moulding.

author: Tima Miroshnichenko
desc: a6. A worker in a brown leather jacket and gloves lowers a welding helmet over his face in the foreground, workshop equipment blurred behind; he adjusts the helmet as the shot holds, serving the skilled factory worker beat.

author: SDG

author: SDG
desc: a6. PROXY, NOT Billund: a drone orbits a tall brick clock tower with a green copper spire in the centre of frame, red rooftops and a sunset cityscape behind; Danish city atmosphere standing in for Billund town, which was not found.

author: Alexis B
desc: a6. PROXY, NOT Billund: at a busy Copenhagen evening intersection, a car crosses right to left in the foreground while a cyclist enters at far left and buildings with a Politiken sign fill the background; traffic flows through, standing in for a Danish town street.

author: Athena Sandrini
desc: a6. Low angle on a colourful Ferris wheel at right with red and yellow gondolas turning slowly, a yellow roller coaster track curving at left against blue sky; generic theme park atmosphere, NOT LEGOLAND Billund, serving the park fun beat.

author: Ricky Esquivel
desc: a6. A roller coaster car speeds along an orange track across the top of frame, with the white Pacific Park Ferris wheel and its sign behind at left; generic theme park energy, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Ricky Esquivel
desc: a6. Wide view of Pacific Park on a pier, the Ferris wheel centred behind a looping coaster, visitors walking along the boardwalk in the foreground; crowds enjoying a theme park day, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: K

author: K

author: K
desc: a6. Aerial view of a Texas amusement park beside a multi-lane road at left, a blue coaster and a red vertical loop at right, cars passing on the road; establishing scale of a large park, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: K
desc: a6. Drone close pass beside a tall red coaster loop at centre, the track curving down to the right with park canopies and trees below; fast ride motion, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: K
desc: a6. Straight top-down drone view of a winding water ride and blue coaster tracks crossing the frame, trees and rooftops between them; the camera drifts over the park layout, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Brien Ordiales
desc: a6. A looping coaster at Fuji-Q Highland fills the middle ground with snow-capped Mount Fuji behind it, a small coaster car cresting a loop at upper right; thrill ride scale, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Simo Herold
desc: a6. Low angle walking view of a huge steel coaster and Ferris wheel structure silhouetted against a cloudy sky, trees at right; the camera moves forward under the track, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Grind 4K videos
desc: a6. Dusk aerial of Santa Monica Pier, the illuminated Ferris wheel glowing at centre, coaster track curving below, beach at left and dark sea at right; evening park atmosphere, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Grind 4K videos
desc: a6. Aerial over Pacific Park at sunset, the lit Ferris wheel at right and a yellow coaster sweeping across the foreground, beach and crowds at right; golden hour park energy, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Grind 4K videos
desc: a6. High aerial of Santa Monica Pier at dusk, the bright Ferris wheel at centre, beach stretching left and sea right, rooftops in the foreground; wide park-by-the-sea view, NOT LEGOLAND Billund.

author: Legoktm
desc: a6. Timelapse of a LEGO Saturn V rocket build on a mat, the part-built white and black rocket standing centre-right, loose bricks, bags and an open instruction booklet spread around it; the build progresses across the timelapse, serving the impressive finished build beat.

author: Klapi
desc: a6. A large yellow and red LEGO Technic helicopter in a display case fills the frame, its main rotor spinning as a blur above it; a second model sits at the right edge, serving the complex Technic build beat.

author: Banej
desc: a6. A LEGO city diorama with detailed buildings across the frame, a yellow bus and a pink car on the street at centre, and a white train speeding along the track at lower right; serves the LEGO town world beat.

author: Andrew Carol
desc: a6. Two black LEGO Technic gear mechanisms sit on a white table, the foreground mechanism centre-left and a second behind at right, grey gears turning as the camera moves around them; serves the ingenious LEGO engineering beat.

author: simonjelley
desc: a6. Close-up of a black LEGO Wimshurst machine, two foil-covered spheres hanging at centre with red wires above, the frame and gears around them; the machine works as the shot holds, serving the working LEGO machine beat.

author: Juampayo Escorpio
desc: a6. Two children sit at right holding game controllers and looking off-frame at a screen, a decorated Christmas tree at centre-left, in warm sepia tones; they are playing the LEGO Marvel's Avengers video game, so this is LEGO play on screen, not physical bricks, serving the modern children playing LEGO beat.

author: Gustavo Fring
desc: a0. A young boy sits on a living room floor surrounded by colourful generic studded plastic bricks, no LEGO logo visible, using a red toy drill on a white baseplate while loose bricks and a half-built vehicle lie around him; beat: a child building with bricks at home.

author: Kampus Production
desc: a0. Two children at a table build tall towers from colourful generic bristle blocks, the boy in glasses placing pieces on a blue tower while the girl works on a green piece beside him; beat: children stacking blocks into towers.

author: Ketut Subiyanto

author: Ivan S

author: Mikhail Nilov

author: Pavel Danilyuk
desc: a0. An adult hand places a small yellow-roofed wooden house onto a wooden train track while a child's hands arrange green trees and houses beside it on a carpet; beat: an adult and a child building a little wooden town.

author: Ksenia Chernaya
desc: a0. A child in a yellow sweater and an adult build a tall tower of plain and coloured wooden blocks on a white floor, the adult's hand adding a block to the top; beat: a child building a block tower with an adult.

author: Artem Podrez
desc: a0. Children sit on a light wooden floor among colourful wooden cubes spilled from an open wooden box, one child arranging four cubes into a square; beat: bricks poured out and spread across the floor.

author: MART  PRODUCTION
desc: a0. Close-up of a child's hands stacking large colourful letter blocks, a yellow letter A held above a red letter H already standing on a blue block; beat: small hands stacking blocks, close up.

author: RDNE Stock project

author: Ksenia Chernaya
desc: a0. A small child kneels on a white wooden floor and plays with a tiny stack of red, green and yellow wooden blocks standing in front of him; beat: a young child building a small block tower.

desc: a3. A deserted outlet shopfront with empty glass windows and a faded OUTLET sign stands behind a littered, empty paved forecourt, no customers in sight; beat: shops left empty and shuttered.

author: Matthias Groeneveld
desc: a3. A long, dim shopping mall corridor stretches empty into the distance, shuttered shopfronts on both sides and a polished floor reflecting the ceiling lights, nobody walking through; beat: the mall with no shoppers left.

author: Max Fischer

author: Max Fischer

author: Richarles Moral

author: Kampus Production
